decision: Owner requested tent, all six clowns and title revised together as rubber-hose 8-bit animation using PixelLab.

font.ownership: Generated for AgentLand; follows the repository artwork ownership. Previous Holtwood font and OFL notice remain packaged.

geometry.why: Home redesign: broader pixel letters on a shallower arch, preserving the circus clock and per-letter animations.
geometry.units: circus scene units (the 336x360 scene; tent 252x252 at (42, 54)), y down

arch.glyphCentres: spread by advance over the sweep; first at -21 degrees, last at +21 degrees
arch.letterTurn: each glyph turned to the circle's normal

geometry.pixelGrid: the tent's art-pixel grid: 2.625 units per pixel, anchored at the tent's origin (42, 54); a pixel is on when at least half covered
geometry.canvas: scene x -107.625 to 443.625, y -98.25 to 14.625 (551.25 x 112.875 units); symmetric about x=168
geometry.bulbs: 33 bulbs of 2x2 pixels on an arc of radius 736 over the same sweep, dark at rest
geometry.quip: not in the arch: Home shows the quip under the tent (AgentLandTitleBlock keeps showsQuip only so existing layouts compile)
geometry.placement: HomeLauncherLayout measures title, tent, quip and actions against safe-area height, with at least 32 points below actions; short-wide layouts place artwork beside actions; accessibility sizes may scroll.
geometry.clearance: WordmarkTests samples every clown and ball on the ring and doorway paths and requires at least 8 scene units.
geometry.roundOne: centre (168, 40), baseline radius 112, 160°, cap height 34, font size 45.33, tracking 1.01, canvas x 13.125-322.875 y -116.625-38.25, the quip in the hollow

rendering.component: Rounded PixelLab font rasterized on the tent grid; existing native per-letter Core Animation and shared five-tone ramp.
rendering.tint: Work surfaces use the same fixed day/night ramps as tent and clowns; tint remains available for explicit monochrome callers.
rendering.animation: Core Animation keyframes on the render server, like the opening circus, on transform.*, opacity and contents only (never position, which identifies the clown's orbit)
rendering.entranceLength: 0.9-1.4 s, played when Home is revealed (uncovered or selected), never on the opening cover
rendering.flourishTiming: every 20-30 s while Home stays visible, and on a tap (which also shows the next quip); started on the circus clock's next 0.3 s beat
rendering.photosensitivity: marquee blink: two dips to 40% opacity, 0.6 s apart (under 2 Hz); each bulb in the chase lights at most twice a second
rendering.picker: seeded random choice, never the same animation twice in a row, and never the previous launch's last entrance (UserDefaults agentland.wordmark.lastEntrance, read defensively)
rendering.motionGate: a still resting pose under Reduce Motion, when hidden, covered, inactive or in the background (macOS: when the app is inactive), and with -AgentLandUITestsDisableAnimations

quips.store: QuipStore: a saved ring of at least 8 quips in UserDefaults (agentland.quips.*), read synchronously; the last 50 shown are never shown again while remembered
quips.onDevice: FoundationModelsQuipProvider: SystemLanguageModel.default, batches of 8 around a random circus theme with guided generation, validated (one line, 3-36 characters, no emoji, quotation marks, markup or links, not among the last 50 shown)
quips.fallback: GrammarQuipProvider: an in-house Tracery-style grammar with a seeded generator and 145,922 derivations of 3-36 characters (counted, not listed), used when Apple Intelligence is off or unavailable and on any error or guardrail refusal
quips.prefetch: about 2 s after Home is revealed, in a detached task at utility priority; never on the main thread and never before the opening clears
quips.testArgument: -AgentLandFixedQuip "<text>" pins one quip for UI tests

redesign.description: Rounded PixelLab rubber-hose title shapes; preserve established shallow arch and motion lifecycle.
redesign.shading: One-pixel outline and stepped bevel, white upper/left highlights, dark lower/right edges; quantized on the tent grid.

copies: macos/licenses/HoltwoodOneSC-OFL.txt (bundled in the Mac app's ThirdPartyNotices by scripts/build-desktop-app.sh)
previousFont.registration: AgentLandWordmarkFont registers the packaged file once per process (CTFontManagerRegisterFontsForURL, .process, in a static initializer) and checks that CoreText resolves the PostScript name HoltwoodOneSC-Regular to it; nothing is installed on a device.
previousFont.notices: iOS Settings > About AgentLand > Open source notices shows the OFL text beside SwiftTerm's; the Mac app bundles it in Contents/Resources/ThirdPartyNotices/.

faces.why: Owner's request: a title font per Home load and font-morph flourishes; open-licence faces chosen on the Title Lab sheet (.evidence/title-fonts-20261004/candidates.png).

list.source: Bundled before this change (Google Fonts ofl/holtwoodonesc); kept as the earlier title face
